title: auth-cluster-3 down — login failures on eu-west-1
description: Since 08:14 UTC all login attempts via the AuthHub SSO portal are failing with HTTP 500 on eu-west-1. The /api/auth/token endpoint returns 'Internal Server Error'. Engineering confirmed auth-cluster-3 is completely unresponsive. Users across the entire EU region cannot authenticate.

title: AuthHub /api/auth/token returning 500 — eu-west-1 users locked out
description: Multiple teams reporting they cannot log in. The AuthHub token endpoint /api/auth/token is throwing 500 errors continuously since ~08:15 UTC. Logs point to auth-cluster-3 as the source. This is blocking all CI/CD pipelines that use service account tokens.

title: Widespread SSO authentication failure — auth-cluster-3 suspected
description: Our monitoring dashboards show a spike of 500-series errors from the AuthHub authentication service starting at 08:14 UTC. The eu-west-1 region is fully impacted. SRE team traceback points to auth-cluster-3 being down. Login failures reported by 47 users so far.

title: Routine password reset request — HR team account
description: The HR team shared service account needs a password reset. The current password has expired per our 90-day rotation policy. Please reset and share the new credentials via the secure vault. No urgency — this is a scheduled maintenance item.
